paragraphs.text: Mississippi State fans in Pontotoc can follow two teams Friday evening. The women’s soccer team plays for a place in the NCAA tournament’s last 16 at 5 p.m. Central on ESPN+. At 6:31 p.m. Central, the men’s basketball team tips off against Penn State on SEC Network in its final game in the Bahamas.

In South Bend, Mississippi State will face a Notre Dame team that knocked it out of the 2024 tournament with a 2–0 win in Starkville. Kara Harris is the only current Bulldog who played in that match. Eight players on the Irish roster appeared in it. A Mississippi State victory would send the program to the Sweet 16 for the third time.

The Bulldogs have held every ranked opponent they have faced this season scoreless. Against Notre Dame, keeping the ball out of their net for the opening eight minutes and 34 seconds would extend their shutout streak to 500 minutes. At the other end of the field, Chiara Tappe has scored Mississippi State’s last three goals.

On the basketball court at Imperial Arena on Paradise Island, both teams start the night 5–2 and both are trying to leave the Battle 4 Atlantis with a win. Mississippi State lost 78–71 to Wake Forest on Wednesday. Penn State lost 83–70 to Memphis that day. The SEC Network broadcast is separate from the soccer stream on ESPN+.
